Reflection:
The Visual Studio Code window is focused on test.py, showing lines 1–10. To indent lines 2–10 by one tab, we’ll use “Go to Line” (Ctrl+G) to jump to line 2, extend the selection down to line 10 with Shift+Down, then press Tab to indent.

```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Open "Go to Line" dialog
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.2)
# Jump to line 2
pyautogui.typewrite('2')
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.2)
# Select from line 2 down through line 10 (8 shifts)
for _ in range(8):
    pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'down')
    time.sleep(0.1)
# Indent selected lines by one tab
pyautogui.press('tab')
```
